name: COMM_TRACE_EMAIL_RECPNTS
description: This table stores information about addresses that an email was sent to as well as the person records associated with that address.

columns.name: OUTREACH_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the outreach record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: COMM_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the communication contact record associated with the external email addresses that an email will be sent to.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDR_RECPNT_TYP_C_NAME
columns.description: The recipient type for a specific email address receiving the email.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the patient associated with a person receiving an email.

columns.name: MYPT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the MyChart user associated with the person receiving the email.

columns.name: ACCT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the guarantor associated with the person receiving the email.

columns.name: PAT_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the patient relationship associated with the person receiving the email.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the user associated with the person receiving the email.

columns.name: USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: COMM_ACTION_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The status of the email for this recipient.

columns.name: NUM_TEMP_FAILURES
columns.description: The number of times an email temporarily failed to deliver before reaching a final status.

columns.name: MARKED_SPAM_YN
columns.description: Whether this recipient marked the email as spam.

columns.name: STATUS_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: UTC instant the status event (I RCH 85617) occurred for this recipient.

columns.name: STATUS_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: Local instant the status event (I RCH 85617) occurred for this recipient.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDR_LEGACY_EXT
columns.description: This item stores the external email address of the recipient when we bridge to legacy email sending via the SMTP server. This item will not be populated on traces sent via Hello World Email. For email recipient information on Hello World traces, see COMM_TRACE_EMAIL_RECPNTS.COMM_CONTACT_ID (links to CCR record).
